mission: Give every model target a truthful connection path, task category, council role, benchmark roadmap, and governed improvement path while making free-first use simple for Buddy users.

readiness_gates.label: Cataloged
readiness_gates.description: The target has an identity, provider, declared task fit, and access note.

readiness_gates.label: Categorized
readiness_gates.description: The target maps to one primary task category and relevant benchmark suites.

readiness_gates.label: Source linked
readiness_gates.description: An official provider or project catalog is recorded.

readiness_gates.label: Setup path
readiness_gates.description: The repository explains the connector, secret reference, sandbox, and approval route.

readiness_gates.label: Exact version
readiness_gates.description: The current executable model ID, version, terms, region, and price have been verified.

readiness_gates.label: Adapter tested
readiness_gates.description: An authenticated adapter passed its provider sandbox and failure tests.

readiness_gates.label: Live benchmark
readiness_gates.description: Comparable signed fixtures produced current quality, latency, reliability, and cost evidence.

bootcamp_path: capture an exact task definition and acceptance checks
build synthetic and owner-generated fixtures with rights metadata
record the unmodified baseline on held-out fixtures
assign the smallest measured gap to an isolated training lane
prefer prompting, retrieval, tools, or adapters before weight training
checkpoint every candidate and preserve rollback
rerun identical held-out, safety, privacy, latency, and cost tests
promote only a verified improvement after required review

workstreams.label: Model source watch
workstreams.description: Track official model catalogs, versions, terms, prices, and deprecations without assuming availability.

workstreams.label: Provider adapter lab
workstreams.description: Build one authenticated, rate-limited, failure-tested adapter at a time.

workstreams.label: Frontier comparison
workstreams.description: Use identical signed fixtures and preserve failures, versions, cost, and latency.

workstreams.label: Open model gap closure
workstreams.description: Turn measured gaps into isolated Buddy Bootcamp drills with rollback and regression gates.

workstreams.label: Opportunity experiments
workstreams.description: Validate customer problems, offers, pricing, and fulfillment before outreach or spending. Income is never guaranteed.

workstreams.label: Dataset package lab
workstreams.description: Create synthetic, owner-generated, or clearly licensed packages with provenance, privacy, contamination, and usefulness tests.

allowed_inputs: synthetic data created for the package
owner-created data with separate training and resale opt-in
verified public-domain or open-license material within its terms
blocked_inputs: provider outputs without training and resale rights
